title: The Shift Operator Calculus for Stationary Time Series Analysis
summary: The article establishes a rigorous shift operator calculus for stationary time series modeling, addressing a certain gap in the literature. It provides proofs of existence and isometry for the transfer function operators $f(B)$ and $f(T)$ where $B$ is the bilateral shift operator and $T$ is the unilateral shift operator for different families of functions $f$.
